# SoftCrafta

SoftCrafta is a digital solutions partner helping businesses with website development, custom software, AI solutions, and SEO and digital growth services.

## Core services
- Website development: landing pages, business websites, portfolio websites, booking websites, e-commerce websites, premium multi-page websites.
- Software development: custom web applications, CRM systems, ERP systems, inventory systems, billing and management software.
- AI solutions: AI website chatbots, WhatsApp AI chatbots, appointment automation, lead qualification, voice AI, and custom AI workflows.
- SEO & digital growth: technical SEO, on-page SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, content and growth strategy, and digital visibility improvements.

## Business model
- Remote and project-based business model.
- Transparent starting prices are published on the website.
- Written project scope and proposal are used before work begins.
- Ongoing support can be provided after delivery.
